speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: The Dermoscopy_Imaging of the chest skin lesion reveals a multicomponent pattern with asymmetry in structure and color. These findings are highly suspicious for malignant melanoma.

speaker: Doctor

The dermoscopy findings showing an asymmetric multicomponent pattern, irregular dots/globules, an atypical pigment network, and a blue-white veil are classic indicators of malignancy. Given your age and the rapid growth of this lesion, I am confident in my assessment.
